title: Gift Unlocks a Memory
source: 2025 department-store Christmas film: father and teenage son reunited by a gift
description: A wordless, song-driven family story: a gift and a needle drop send the receiver into a vivid memory, then back home into a hug, closing on a soft-focus end card with one super and the brand.
prompt30: Make a 30 s holiday film for our new wireless speaker: a teenage daughter's gift sends her mother back to a memory of dancing at her first concert, then they hug.
